```{r}
library(RieszCML)
library(nadir)

simulate_data <- function(n, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  L1 <- rnorm(n)
  L2 <- rnorm(n)
  L3 <- rnorm(n)
  L4 <- rnorm(n)

  eta_A <- -0.4 +
    1.2 * sin(L1) -
    0.8 * L2^2 +
    0.7 * L3 * L4 +
    0.5 * (L1 > 0) -
    0.5 * (L2 > 1)

  g <- expit(eta_A)
  A <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = g)

  eta_Y <- -0.8 +
    0.8 * A +
    0.6 * A * L1 -
    0.5 * A * (L2 > 0) +
    0.7 * sin(L1 * L3) +
    0.4 * L2^2 -
    0.3 * abs(L4)

  Q <- expit(eta_Y)
  Y <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = Q)

  data.frame(L1 = L1, L2 = L2, L3 = L3, L4 = L4, A = A, Y = Y)
}

truth_ate_mc <- function(n_mc = 2e6, seed = 123) {
  df_mc <- simulate_data(n_mc, seed = seed)

  eta_Y1 <- with(df_mc,
    -0.8 +
      0.8 * 1 +
      0.6 * 1 * L1 -
      0.5 * 1 * (L2 > 0) +
      0.7 * sin(L1 * L3) +
      0.4 * L2^2 -
      0.3 * abs(L4)
  )

  eta_Y0 <- with(df_mc,
    -0.8 +
      0.8 * 0 +
      0.6 * 0 * L1 -
      0.5 * 0 * (L2 > 0) +
      0.7 * sin(L1 * L3) +
      0.4 * L2^2 -
      0.3 * abs(L4)
  )

  mean(plogis(eta_Y1) - plogis(eta_Y0))
}

truth_ate <- truth_ate_mc()
truth_ate

make_rc_ate <- function(nuis_fun) {
  riesz_curve_catalog$ate(
    L = "L",
    A = "A",
    Y = "Y",
    nuis = nuis_fun
  )
}

make_nuis_superlearner_nocf <- function() {
  function(data) {
    outcome_formula <- Y ~ A + L1 + L2 + L3 + L4 +
      I(L1 * L3) + I(L2^2) + I(abs(L4)) + A:L1 + A:I(L2 > 0)

    prop_formula <- A ~ L1 + L2 + L3 + L4 +
      I(sin(L1)) + I(L2^2) + I(L3 * L4) + I(L1 > 0) + I(L2 > 1)

    m_fit <- nadir::super_learner(
      data = data,
      formula = outcome_formula,
      learners = list(nadir::lnr_logistic, nadir::lnr_rf_binary, nadir::lnr_xgboost, nadir::lnr_glmnet),
      outcome_type = "binary"
    )

    g_fit <- nadir::super_learner(
      data = data,
      formula = prop_formula,
      learners = list(nadir::lnr_logistic, nadir::lnr_rf_binary, nadir::lnr_xgboost, nadir::lnr_glmnet),
      outcome_type = "binary"
    )

    data1 <- data
    data0 <- data
    data1$A <- 1
    data0$A <- 0

    list(
      m = predict(m_fit, data),
      m1 = predict(m_fit, data1),
      m0 = predict(m_fit, data0),
      g = predict(g_fit, data)
    )
  }
}

set.seed(1)
df <- simulate_data(4000, seed = 1)

rc_ate_nocf <- make_rc_ate(make_nuis_superlearner_nocf())
fit_ate_nocf <- riesz_tmle(
  data = df,
  rc = rc_ate_nocf,
  fluctuation = "logistic",
  bounds = c(0, 1),
  outcome_col = "Y"
)

fit_ate_nocf
c(estimate = fit_ate_nocf$estimate, truth = truth_ate)
```


# Now with Cross-Fitting

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = Inf)
make_folds <- function(n, V = 5, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  sample(rep(seq_len(V), length.out = n))
}

make_nuis_superlearner_cf <- function(V = 5, seed = 1) {
  function(data) {
    n <- nrow(data)
    fold_id <- make_folds(n, V = V, seed = seed)

    m_hat <- numeric(n)
    m1_hat <- numeric(n)
    m0_hat <- numeric(n)
    g_hat <- numeric(n)

    outcome_formula <- Y ~ A + L1 + L2 + L3 + L4 +
      I(L1 * L3) + I(L2^2) + I(abs(L4)) + A:L1 + A:I(L2 > 0)

    prop_formula <- A ~ L1 + L2 + L3 + L4 +
      I(sin(L1)) + I(L2^2) + I(L3 * L4) + I(L1 > 0) + I(L2 > 1)

    for (v in seq_len(V)) {
      train_idx <- which(fold_id != v)
      valid_idx <- which(fold_id == v)

      train <- data[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
      valid <- data[valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]

      m_fit <- nadir::super_learner(
        data = train,
        formula = outcome_formula,
      learners = list(nadir::lnr_logistic, nadir::lnr_rf_binary, nadir::lnr_xgboost, nadir::lnr_glmnet),
      outcome_type = "binary"
      )

      g_fit <- nadir::super_learner(
        data = train,
        formula = prop_formula,
      learners = list(nadir::lnr_logistic, nadir::lnr_rf_binary, nadir::lnr_xgboost, nadir::lnr_glmnet),
      outcome_type = "binary"
      )

      valid1 <- valid
      valid0 <- valid
      valid1$A <- 1
      valid0$A <- 0

      m_hat[valid_idx] <- predict(m_fit, valid)
      m1_hat[valid_idx] <- predict(m_fit, valid1)
      m0_hat[valid_idx] <- predict(m_fit, valid0)
      g_hat[valid_idx] <- predict(g_fit, valid)
    }

    list(
      m = m_hat,
      m1 = m1_hat,
      m0 = m0_hat,
      g = g_hat
    )
  }
}
rc_ate_cf <- make_rc_ate(make_nuis_superlearner_cf(V = 5, seed = 1))
fit_ate_cf <- riesz_tmle(
  data = df,
  rc = rc_ate_cf,
  fluctuation = "logistic",
  bounds = c(0, 1),
  use_intercept_and_weights = FALSE,
  outcome_col = "Y"
)

fit_ate_cf
c(estimate = fit_ate_cf$estimate, truth = truth_ate)
```
